scripts.dev:web: npm run build --workspace @cotta/shared && npm run dev --workspace @cotta/web -- --host 0.0.0.0
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @cotta/shared && npm run build --workspace cotta && npm run build --workspace @cotta/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @cotta/shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @cotta/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @cotta/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace cotta && npm run typecheck --workspace @cotta/web
